name: Freedon Nadd learns from Naga Sadow's spirit
summary: Denied knighthood, the Jedi student Freedon Nadd killed his master and followed rumours of Sith lore to Yavin 4, where he woke Naga Sadow. Sadow taught him the Sith arts; Nadd repaid him by killing him and leaving with his secrets.

name: Freedon Nadd makes himself king of Onderon
summary: Nadd landed on the primitive jungle world Onderon and used Sith power to rule it as a god-king from the walled city of Iziz. His dynasty kept his dark teachings alive for four hundred years after his death.

name: The Beast Wars of Onderon
summary: Iziz exiled its criminals beyond the walls, where they learned to tame the beasts of Dxun and became the Beast Riders. Centuries of raids between the riders and Nadd's dark-side monarchy followed, until the Republic sent Jedi to mediate.

name: The Vultar Cataclysm
summary: A group of Dark Jedi, after a brief schism within the Order, tried to activate the ancient Cosmic Turbine machines they found in the Vultar system. The machinery tore the system apart and killed them all, ending the Third Great Schism almost as soon as it began.

name: Mandalorian Crusaders conquer Basilisk
summary: The Mandalorian Crusaders overran the reptilian Basiliskans and seized their war droids. The Basilisk droid became the Mandalorians' signature weapon for the next millennium of raiding.

name: Arca Jeth sends his students to Onderon
summary: At the Republic's request Jedi Master Arca Jeth of Arkania dispatched Ulic Qel-Droma, Cay Qel-Droma and Tott Doneeta to end the Beast Wars. They found a royal court steeped in the dark side and a queen who drew power from Freedon Nadd's remains.

name: End of the Beast Wars
summary: Arca Jeth arrived in person to break Queen Amanoa's dark-side hold on Iziz, and the Beast Lord Oron Kira married Princess Galia to unite the warring sides. Nadd's sarcophagus was ordered removed from the city.

name: The Naddist uprising
summary: Followers of Freedon Nadd led by the undead King Ommin rose against the new regime, stole Nadd's sarcophagus and captured Master Arca. Ulic Qel-Droma and Republic forces put down the revolt, and Ommin was destroyed.

name: Nadd and Amanoa are entombed on Dxun
summary: To keep Nadd's remains away from his worshippers, the Jedi sealed him and Queen Amanoa in a Mandalorian-iron tomb on the jungle moon Dxun. The tomb became a lure for every dark-side seeker who followed, from Exar Kun to Darth Bane.

name: Satal and Aleema Keto obtain Sith teachings
summary: The bored heirs of Empress Teta stole a Sith spellbook on Coruscant and travelled to Onderon to have it translated, arriving in the middle of the Naddist revolt. King Ommin and the spirit of Freedon Nadd gave them the knowledge they wanted.

name: Founding of the Krath
summary: Back on Empress Teta, the Keto cousins turned their society of jaded aristocrats into the Krath, a dark-side cult practising the Sith magic they had learned on Onderon. Within a year it had a navy.

name: The Krath seize the Tetan throne
summary: Satal and Aleema murdered their own family and took control of the Koros system's seven worlds. The Tetan monarchy that had saved Coruscant a thousand years earlier became the first Sith-aligned state in Republic space since the Hyperspace War.

name: The Krath Holy Crusade

location.note: raids into the Deep Core and neighbouring systems

summary: The Krath launched raids out of the Koros system against nearby Republic worlds, using Sith illusions to make their fleets look larger than they were and sacrificing prisoners in dark rituals.

name: Battle of Koros Major
summary: A Republic fleet with Jedi aboard tried to retake the Koros system and was thrown back by Aleema Keto's illusions. Ulic Qel-Droma was wounded by a Sith sorcery blast, and the Republic learned it faced something more than a palace coup.

name: Krath attack on the Deneba conclave
summary: Thousands of Jedi gathered on Mount Meru to debate the Krath threat when Krath war droids rained down on the camp. Master Arca Jeth died saving Ulic Qel-Droma, who swore to destroy the cult from within.

name: Ulic Qel-Droma infiltrates the Krath
summary: Against the advice of Nomi Sunrider and the Jedi Masters, Ulic went to Cinnagar posing as a fallen Jedi to bring down the Krath from inside. Aleema Keto welcomed him into her bed and her court.

name: Ulic Qel-Droma falls to the dark side
summary: Satal Keto poisoned Ulic with Sith alchemy to bind him to the dark side; Ulic killed Satal in revenge and found he no longer wished to leave. He became the Krath warlord and turned away the Jedi who came to rescue him.

name: Exar Kun studies forbidden Sith teachings
summary: The gifted and arrogant Jedi student Exar Kun secretly read the Sith records his master Vodo-Siosk Baas kept on Dantooine. Convinced he could master the dark side without being mastered, he left to find more.

name: Exar Kun opens Freedon Nadd's tomb
summary: Kun travelled to Onderon and Dxun to seek the source of the Naddists' power. In Nadd's tomb the dead king's spirit offered him Sith scrolls and sent him onward to Korriban.

name: Exar Kun falls to the dark side on Korriban
summary: In the Valley of the Dark Lords a cave-in crushed Kun, and Nadd's spirit offered to save him if he gave himself to the dark side. Kun accepted. He rose healed, far stronger, and no longer a Jedi.

name: Exar Kun claims Yavin 4 and destroys Nadd's spirit
summary: Nadd sent Kun to Yavin 4, where the Massassi tried to sacrifice him to a Sith wyrm. Kun slew the wyrm, bent the Massassi to his will, used Sadow's temples to amplify his power, and then obliterated Nadd's spirit rather than serve it.

name: Kun and Qel-Droma are anointed Dark Lords; the Brotherhood of the Sith is born
summary: Kun came to Cinnagar to kill the upstart Krath warlord, and the two duelled until the spirit of Marka Ragnos stopped them. Ragnos named Kun Dark Lord of the Sith and Ulic his apprentice, and the Krath became the first army of the Brotherhood of the Sith.

name: The Jedi and the Republic crush the Krath
summary: Speculative. Without Exar Kun's Brotherhood behind it the Krath would have stayed a regional cult, and the Republic fleet and Jedi that had already fought it at Koros Major would have retaken the Koros system within a year.
basis: Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith shows the Republic already mounting fleet actions against the Krath before Kun's arrival; the cult's reach beyond Koros came entirely through the Brotherhood.
